notes.title: In three days, we're going release! Announce a good news!
notes.notes:
Latest News!
《 Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn 》will be available worldwide on Steam on August 29 at 03:00AM(PDT)!
At the recent Busan Indie Connect Festival 2024（BIC） held in Korea, “Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn” was nominated for three awards: “EXCELLENCE IN ACTION”, “JURY PRIZE” and “GRAND PRIX”! It was nominated and ultimately won the “EXCELLENCE IN ACTION” award!The game is about to be released! Are you ready to play the game?
